name: Rulership
body:
Granted Powers: You can compel your enemies to obey your wishes with your royal bearing and appeal to your deity to fill you with divine power. A cleric with access to the nobility domain can select this domain in its place.

On Bended Knee (Sp)

When you make a successful melee touch attack against a target, the target falls prone. You can use this ability a number of times per day equal to 3 + your Wisdom modifier.

Voice of Authority (Su)

At 8th level, as a standard action, you can compel creatures to do your bidding. This ability functions exactly as forbid action, greaterum. You can use this ability once per day at 8th level, and an additional time per day for every four levels beyond 8th.

Domain: 1st-command, 2nd-weapon of aweapg, 3rd-righteous vigor, 4th-divine power, 5th-castigate, mass, 6th-king’s castle, 7thlimited wish, 8th-divine vessel (axiomatic aspect only), 9th-overwhelming presence.
